title: Blackburne's mate
line: Two bishops and a knight around the castled king.

steps.text: Blackburne's mate: one bishop on the long diagonal takes g7 and h8. A knight guards h7, and the other bishop mates there.
Tap the white piece that will guard your bishop when it lands next to the king.
steps.after: The knight guards h7, so the king cannot take the bishop there.

steps.hint: The bishop takes the pawn in front of the king.
steps.after: Checkmate. The far bishop takes g7 and h8, and Black's own rook and pawn block the rest.

steps.text: Now you are Black, and White has just brought the knight to g5 for this mate. Take away one of its pieces.

wrong.a7a6: Then the bishop takes on h7, and it is mate.
wrong.b7b6: Then the bishop takes on h7, and it is mate.
wrong.a8b8: Then the bishop takes on h7, and it is mate.
wrong.a8c8: Then the bishop takes on h7, and it is mate.

steps.hint: Without the knight, the bishop on h7 could be taken.
steps.after: The knight is gone, and nothing guards h7 any more.

summary: A bishop on the long diagonal and a knight beside the king let the other bishop mate. Remove one, and it fails.
